agent_responses.response_str:
1. Install Python and the required package:

`python -m pip install openpyxl`

If your computer uses `python3`, use:

`python3 -m pip install openpyxl`

2. Copy the code below into a new file named `create_invoice.py`:

    from datetime import date
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Border, Font, PatternFill, Side

    OUTPUT_FILE = "Acme_Invoice_INV-2024-001.xlsx"

    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Invoice"
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

    # Colors and formats
    navy = "1F4E78"
    blue = "5B9BD5"
    light_blue = "D9EAF7"
    white = "FFFFFF"
    gray = "B7B7B7"
    currency = '$#,##0.00'
    date_format = "mmmm d, yyyy"

    thin_side = Side(style="thin", color=gray)
    cell_border = Border(
        left=thin_side,
        right=thin_side,
        top=thin_side,
        bottom=thin_side,
    )

    # Column widths
    widths = {
        "A": 23,
        "B": 28,
        "C": 12,
        "D": 16,
        "E": 16,
    }

    for column, width in widths.items():
        ws.column_dimensions[column].width = width

    # Title
    ws.merge_cells("A1:E1")
    ws["A1"] = "INVOICE"
    ws["A1"].font = Font(size=22, bold=True, color=white)
    ws["A1"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=navy)
    ws["A1"].alignment = Alignment(
        horizontal="center",
        vertical="center",
    )
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 34

    # Vendor information
    ws.merge_cells("A3:C3")
    ws["A3"] = "FROM"
    ws["A3"].font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
    ws["A3"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=blue)

    ws.merge_cells("A4:C4")
    ws["A4"] = "Acme Supplies Inc."
    ws["A4"].font = Font(size=13, bold=True, color=navy)

    ws.merge_cells("A5:C5")
    ws["A5"] = "123 Main Street"

    ws.merge_cells("A6:C6")
    ws["A6"] = "Springfield, IL 62701"

    ws.merge_cells("A7:C7")
    ws["A7"] = "(555) 123-4567"

    ws.merge_cells("A8:C8")
    ws["A8"] = "billing@acmesupplies.com"

    # Invoice details
    invoice_details = [
        ("D3", "Invoice Number", "E3", "INV-2024-001"),
        ("D4", "Invoice Date", "E4", date(2024, 6, 1)),
        ("D5", "Due Date", "E5", date(2024, 6, 15)),
    ]

    for label_cell, label, value_cell, value in invoice_details:
        ws[label_cell] = label
        ws[label_cell].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
        ws[label_cell].fill = PatternFill(
            "solid",
            fgColor=light_blue,
        )
        ws[label_cell].border = cell_border

        ws[value_cell] = value
        ws[value_cell].border = cell_border
        ws[value_cell].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")

    ws["E4"].number_format = date_format
    ws["E5"].number_format = date_format

    # Customer information
    ws.merge_cells("A10:E10")
    ws["A10"] = "BILL TO"
    ws["A10"].font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
    ws["A10"].fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=blue)

    ws.merge_cells("A11:E11")
    ws["A11"] = "Alice Smith"
    ws["A11"].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)

    ws.merge_cells("A12:E12")
    ws["A12"] = (
        "Alice Consulting — "
        "456 Oak Avenue, Springfield, IL 62702"
    )

    # Line-item table
    headers = [
        "Description",
        "Details",
        "Quantity",
        "Unit Price",
        "Amount",
    ]

    for column_number, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=14, column=column_number, value=header)
        cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=white)
        cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=navy)
        cell.border = cell_border
        cell.alignment = Alignment(
            horizontal="center",
            vertical="center",
        )

    items = [
        ("Office Paper", "500 sheets", 10, 5.00),
        ("Ink Cartridge", "", 2, 30.00),
    ]

    for row_number, item in enumerate(items, start=15):
        description, details, quantity, unit_price = item

        ws.cell(row=row_number, column=1, value=description)
        ws.cell(row=row_number, column=2, value=details)
        ws.cell(row=row_number, column=3, value=quantity)
        ws.cell(row=row_number, column=4, value=unit_price)

        # Formula: quantity multiplied by unit price
        ws.cell(
            row=row_number,
            column=5,
            value=f"=C{row_number}*D{row_number}",
        )

        for column_number in range(1, 6):
            cell = ws.cell(
                row=row_number,
                column=column_number,
            )
            cell.border = cell_border
            cell.alignment = Alignment(
                horizontal=(
                    "center" if column_number >= 3 else "left"
                ),
                vertical="center",
            )

        ws.cell(
            row=row_number,
            column=4,
        ).number_format = currency

        ws.cell(
            row=row_number,
            column=5,
        ).number_format = currency

    # Totals
    ws["D18"] = "Subtotal"
    ws["E18"] = "=SUM(E15:E16)"

    ws["D19"] = "Tax (8%)"
    ws["E19"] = "=E18*8%"

    ws["D20"] = "TOTAL"
    ws["E20"] = "=E18+E19"

    for row_number in range(18, 21):
        fill = navy if row_number == 20 else light_blue
        text_color = white if row_number == 20 else navy

        for column in ("D", "E"):
            cell = ws[f"{column}{row_number}"]
            cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=text_color)
            cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=fill)
            cell.border = cell_border

        ws[f"E{row_number}"].number_format = currency
        ws[f"E{row_number}"].alignment = Alignment(
            horizontal="right"
        )

    # Payment terms and note
    ws["A22"] = "Payment Terms:"
    ws["A22"].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
    ws["B22"] = "Net 14"

    ws["A23"] = "Notes:"
    ws["A23"].font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)

    ws.merge_cells("B23:E23")
    ws["B23"] = "Thank you for your business!"
    ws["B23"].font = Font(italic=True)

    # General presentation and printing
    for row in ws.iter_rows(
        min_row=1,
        max_row=23,
        min_col=1,
        max_col=5,
    ):
        for cell in row:
            current_horizontal = cell.alignment.horizontal
            cell.alignment = Alignment(
                horizontal=current_horizontal,
                vertical="center",
                wrap_text=True,
            )

    ws.freeze_panes = "A15"
    ws.print_area = "A1:E23"
    ws.page_setup.orientation = "portrait"
    ws.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
    ws.page_setup.fitToHeight = 1
    ws.sheet_properties.pageSetUpPr.fitToPage = True

    wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
    print(f"Created: {OUTPUT_FILE}")

3. Open Terminal or Command Prompt in the folder containing the script.

4. Run:

`python create_invoice.py`

Or, if applicable:

`python3 create_invoice.py`

5. The script will create `Acme_Invoice_INV-2024-001.xlsx` in that same folder. When opened in Excel, its formulas calculate:

- Office Paper: $50.00
- Ink Cartridge: $60.00
- Subtotal: $110.00
- Tax: $8.80
- Total: $118.80
